changed.what: (1) Law 5 said the barrier's gradient is −x⁻¹ checked by central differences. In coordinates that holds for the orthant and the semidefinite cone, but for the second-order cone −ln(x₀² − ‖x̄‖²) has gradient −2·x⁻¹ (its trace is 2·x₀), and for a linear image −2·Tᵀ·(T·x)⁻¹; a correct implementation would fail laws_barrier_soc and laws_barrier_friction. The law now states the trace-form statement, the coordinate forms per cone and the hand value (−4/3, 2/3, 0) at (2, 1, 0). (2) Two mutant criteria claimed a catch on 'every' point; the clip mutant's 10⁻⁶ vanishes in rounding next to the boundary set's 10³⁰ eigenvalues and the damped map's 0.09·(x − P(x)) vanishes for points within tolerance of the cone, so a test asserting 'every' fails on a correct mutant. Both now say 'whose planted change exceeds the tolerance'. (3) The four registered mutants had no planting form; under BD-025 a mutation control needs a per-control feature, so the loader would refuse them with feature-missing and N13-19 could not catch them. They are now cfg(feature = "nc-<nnnn>") branches of frob-algebra, one build per control, run by the e2e script. (4) The SPEC-C-06 criterion now names laws_c06.rs, its move from frob-conformance if staged there and its per-control builds (N10a-01 section 6 point 3). Rechecked: every projection, Jordan product, PSD and friction value, the oracle's 14/5, the dual boundary (0.5, −1) and the pyramid point.
